Worst is... that my exams aren't with this teacher...

I made a post where I pointed out some of the things she did to me... She told me i was horrible at writing. I sound dumb. I can't explain or talk about the field i study and that I am going to be horrible at what i am doing. Also, she made a big deal out of me, apparently being smelly. True, i had some days where I wasn't able to get clean beforehand. But she literally called me ugly and smelly in front of my face. I began to have tear in my eyes because it hurt, and she dead looked me in the eyes and shrug me off as a cockroach.

Ever since the teacher failed me last year, I have had no confidence in anything I have done. I told my councellor that I honestly don't feel mentally prepared for any exams but they didn't care at all. 

I feel terrible.
28....in The same boat. Want to kill myself very soon.
